note: each clearing a state of the plain mesh (no carving), scored and drawn as the road frames are; D the cleared buildings' population share (area weights); LP, Pq, J2 the lenses on the plain baseline; own_LP the method's L_P under the metric it optimized; gains over the plain baseline

simp.name: SIMP
simp.how: Relaxes every building to a fraction cleared, moves the fractions down P's gradient within the budget as the penalty stiffens to whole buildings, rounds, then polishes by exact swaps.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.how: Clears a batch at a time, each to the next 1% of the people, the buildings whose clearing lowers P most per person to first order, spread over different catchments; one run cut at each budget.

cheap.name: Greedy + polish
cheap.how: The greedy to the budget, then up to 64 exact swaps of a cleared building for a standing one, each the best of eight ranked by P's gradient.

ff.name: SIMP, every home counted
ff.how: SIMP optimized under the rule that counts every walled-in home's trip from its own ground, the better of starting from nothing and from the cheapest crossings that free them; scored here under the page's metric.
